name: ticket-lock
summary: One owner per ticket: a second worker for a held ticket is refused until the first finishes, a handoff is written, or the lock expires.

env.TICKET_LOCK_ALARM_LOG: where handoff and mismatch alarms are appended, default $HUBKIT_HOME/state/ticket-alarms.log
env.TICKET_LOCK_TTL_S: seconds before a lock counts as expired, default 3600
env.TICKET_LOCK_ID_RE: optional pattern for a ticket id, default L- plus four digits
env.TICKET_LOCK_PROJECTS_GLOB: where subagent transcripts live (a test seam; {sid} is the session id), default ~/.claude/projects/*/{sid}/subagents/agent-*.jsonl
env.TICKET_LOCK_SESSION_GLOB: where the claiming session's own transcript lives (a test seam; {sid} is the session id), default ~/.claude/projects/*/{sid}.jsonl
